title: Asset owners double down on commitment to net zero by 2050
lede: Net Zero Asset Owners Alliance retains 1.5C target, announces details of new 'observer' status for non-members.

title: Spain’s Hernández de Cos tapped to succeed fellow ‘owl’ Lagarde as ECB president
lede: Neither dove nor hawk, the former Bank of Spain governor describes himself as an 'owl' when it comes to monetary policy, just like his predecessor Christine Lagarde did when she took over the helm in 2019.
